entries.description: Daily mutation #164: Color scheme → sunflower (warm summer gold), new hero tagline, all 5 headings rewritten with fresh poetic language, all fact/quote indices rotated dramatically, Today section fully rewritten, new sunflower field SVG visual asset
changes: Color scheme rotated: starry-night → sunflower (warm gold #f5c800 + orange #ff6f00 + green #2e7d32), reordered array so dayOfYear%5=2 selects sunflower
Hero tagline: 'Beneath the golden hush of a summer sky, the soul remembers how to bloom' (was 'Every darkness is a canvas waiting for its stars')
Rewrote all 5 section headings with fresh poetic language and <em> emphasis:

Moon: 'The silence between two heartbeats of light' | Philosophy: 'Where the self dissolves into the sea' | Gita: 'The courage to act without claiming the fruit' | Shiva: 'The flame at the center of the whirl' | Art: 'The brushstroke that outlives the hand'

Rotated imageCard factIndex: Moon=7 (Moon drifting away 3.8cm/yr), Philosophy=9 (Dunning-Kruger effect), Gita=11 (Gita renounce attachment to outcomes), Shiva=2 (Shiva drank poison Halahala), Art=10 (color as conversation between light and perception)

Rotated facts.slice: Moon=[0,2] (Selene chariot, Moon controls tides), Philosophy=[12,14] (ego castle on sand, humility river/ocean), Gita=[6,8] (divine returns to restore balance, 700 verses in 90 min), Shiva=[14,16] (Shiva both ascetic/householder, crescent moon as time), Art=[3,5] (flute oldest instrument, waves ocean-shore communication)

Rotated quoteIndex: Moon=2 (Blake: Moon like a flower in heaven's bower), Philosophy=8 (Atrijā: ego tight fist/soul open hand), Gita=3 (Gita 2.64: self-controlled soul wins eternal peace), Shiva=5 (Inspired: dancer and dance become one), Art=5 (Santayana: Earth has music for those who listen)
Rewrote Today heading: 'The language of light at its fullest'
Rewrote Today intro: morning unfurling, sunflower greeting the day, light arriving in waves, world shining without apology

Generated new SVG visual asset: visual.svg — impressionist sunflower field at golden hour with vivid golds (#f5c800, #fbbf24), bright greens (#22c55e), warm oranges (#f97316), luminous sky (#4a90d9, #6bb5ff), impressionist brushstroke texture
